messages:
Sanjay: Started 550 canary rollout to ~3% of fleet in us-west2 (g4dn / p4d pools). Seeing ~8 nodes fail provisioning — they hang during DKMS/module build and never finish booting. Posting a short log extract. :eyes:

Chloe: Can you paste the logs / which step fails? Any differences vs staging?

Sanjay: Log snippet from one failed node:
```
DKMS: Building module, please wait...
make -C /lib/modules/5.15.0-101-generic/build M=/var/lib/dkms/nvidia/550/build
make[1]: *** /lib/modules/5.15.0-101-generic/build: No such file or directory.  Stop.
dkms: ERROR: could not locate kernel source tree for kernel 5.15.0-101-generic.
Error! Bad return status for module build on kernel: 5.15.0-101-generic (x86_64)
See: /var/lib/dkms/nvidia/550/build/make.log
```

Mike: That looks like kernel-headers / build-essentials missing on the AMI. We've hit an image bake race where headers aren't installed for the running kernel. Also could be cloud-init switching kernels post-bake.

Ana: Confirmed on two repro nodes: linux-headers-5.15.0-101 isn't installed. AMI manifest shows headers step was skipped due to a transient apt hang during image build. I also saw modprobe failures later because /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-nouveau was not applied in the image.

Oliver: Affected nodes also show CUDA probe failures in cloud-init: "cuda: failed to detect driver via nvidia-smi" which causes fallback to CPU paths and NCCL tests to emit timeout/warning noise. That'll surface as training job instability.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated for canary cohort (550 -> 535), job id r-20260318-33 :warning:

Jules: Repro script for eng-sre to run on a fresh instance (one-liner):
```
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y dkms linux-headers-$(uname -r) build-essential && sudo dkms autoinstall
```

Chloe: Can we add a preflight check to provisioning that validates: headers present, dkms build succeeds, nvidia-smi returns driver/version? If we gate rollouts on that the AMI mistake won't reach prod.

Mike: Short-term mitigation: taint the AMIs used in the failed cohort, disable 550 in us-west2, and re-run canary using a patched image. Also add an automated check for "No such file or directory" in DKMS make logs to auto-abort rollouts.

Sanjay: Plan: 1) pause rollout (done), 2) Jules to collect full /var/lib/dkms logs and machine-info from all failed nodes (in progress), 3) notify customers with running jobs in affected pools, 4) rebuild AMI with headers baked and run extended staging, 5) re-run canary on patched AMI tomorrow. ETA ~24h.

Jules: I'll attach logs to the ticket and spin up 5 repro nodes now. Ping @eng-sre if you need SSH. I'll also run the dkms autoinstall and capture make.log for each.

Sanjay: Thanks — please also capture distro-release and uname -a for each node so we can correlate any kernel variations. I'll follow up with a brief incident note once we have logs. :thumbsup:
